title: Buckets Re-Designed
description: A lightweight vanilla-friendly resource pack that redesigns the buckets with softer pastel colors, and a few texture tweaks!
body:
What it changes:

Water Color:
Water buckets now use a softer pastel blue color!

Lava Texture:
the Lava has been changed to a lighter, peachier tone!

Other Buckets:
Fish, axolotl, powder snow, and other bucket variants have also had their colors and shapes updated to match the new style!

Hope you enjoy <3
